utterances.text: First, switch the boiler off at the isolator.
The light on the front panel goes out.
Next, remove the front cover. There are two screws underneath.
Okay, then lift the cover away
then set it down somewhere safe.
Step three. Check the fuse on the control board.
Next, vacuum the dust out of the burner tray.
Once that's done, refit the cover. New step. Restore the power.
